items.quote: Awesome service from Handy Dude Rob! Timely and skilled! He's a reliable handyman who tackles all my home repairs. He's done plumbing for me and helped fix my car. He has affordable rates and is the nicest person. Top-notch craftsmanship. Highly recommend for all your handyman needs!

Rob was amazing to work with! He was quick and diligent with every house project we needed done. We ended up having him do projects three days in a row because he was so helpful! His work helped us complete our house renovation. Would definitely recommend and use his handyman services again!

While Rob was replacing parking curbs at a local auto parts store, I needed a tool to remove my trailer ball. He offered his wrench for me to use after seeing that I was stuck! I cannot begin to thank him for his kindness and professionalism. Rob is a definite must in the Tampa/St. Petersburg area who I highly recommend!
